messages:
shilpa: Heads up — nightly perf regression popped after yesterday's shrinkwrap merge. p99 latency up ~35% on small-seq workloads. CI job: https://ci.redwood/runner/9821 :alarm_clock:
ci-bot: nightly/perf-small-seq failed (p99 delta +34%). Attached flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/fg/9821.svg
ben: Oh no. Which merge? shrinkwrap PR #547 — it swapped kernel selector to prefer 'fused-attn-v2' for seq<=128.
matt: I can repro locally on my devbox with the same benchmark. Steps I used:
```
git checkout main
git pull
git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad
git bisect good <good-sha>
git bisect bad <head-sha>
# run microbench
./scripts/perf/run_bench.sh --model llama --seq 64 --iters 50
```
result: p99 jumped from ~18ms -> ~26ms on my RTX A6000 clone.
shilpa: Thanks Matt. Ben, do you think the selector change could interact with KV cache prefetching? New kernel swaps change scoring for batch prefetch heuristics.
ben: Likely. The 'fused-attn-v2' kernel has different warmup characteristics and a larger setup overhead. If the batcher sees increased variance, it may reduce coalescing and increase token generation latency.
liam: I'll start a focused git bisect on the shrinkwrap range. If anyone has a minimal repro we'll use that to speed up. Matt, can you paste the exact perf command and env?
matt: Sure — paste below.
```
export LD_PRELOAD=libtcmalloc.so
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
./build/bin/serve_bench --model=/models/llama7b --seq=64 --batch=1 --tokens=256 --profile=flame
```
It produces the attached pprof (local): /tmp/pprof-1901.gz and flame svg.
shilpa: Good. Liam, add the bisect steps to the PR checklist and ping infra for a small on-demand node. We need reproducible CI config.
liam: On it. Starting bisect now, will run the microbench per-commit, stopping on the first bad commit. ETA ~45m depending on test runtime.
infra-bot: Request received. Provisioning gpu-small-1 (A10G) for 1 hour. Endpoint: gpu://on-demand/1234
ben: If bisect points to the selector change, consider temporarily reverting to previous kernel ranking while we profile. Quick mitigation: pin kernel preference for seq<=128 to 'attn-v1' via runtime flag: `--kernel-rank=attn-v1,attn-v2`
shilpa: Agreed. Also capture KV cache hit/miss stats during runs: add `--kv-stats=1` to the bench and log into /tmp/kv-stats.json. We suspect more cold misses.
matt: Re-ran with kv-stats — misses increased from 2% -> 8% under the new kernel. That aligns with prefetch being less effective.
liam: Bisect update: narrowed to 3 commits. Candidate commit is 8a7c3d (kernel selector rewrite). Running detailed profile on that one.
ci-bot: Note: canary rollout paused due to p99 regression. Release manager notified.
ben: OK once bisect confirms, we should prepare a minimal revert PR and test. I'll draft the revert and add the kernel flag as toggle.
shilpa: Also we should add a unit perf test for small-seq path to prevent regressions. Make it run in CI cheap mode.
matt: From flamegraphs, most added time is in `KernelInit::prepare` and `BatchCoalescer::flush`. I'll open a profiling ticket with screenshots.
liam: Bisect finished: bad commit is 8a7c3d — confirms selector rewrite. Posting bisect log: /tmp/bisect-log-1901.txt
shilpa: Great job. Ben, please open revert PR and mark for urgent review. I'll coordinate the canary rollback and re-run nightly. :thumbsup:
ben: Filed PR #563 revert kernel selector rewrite. Added toggle and perf test.
infra-bot: Canary rollback scheduled at 2026-03-18T03:00Z.
shilpa: After rollback, let's plan a follow-up: iterate on selector heuristics to account for setup overhead and KV caching. Assigning to eng-runtime.
matt: I'll help measure warmup vs steady-state costs across kernels.
liam: Closing this thread — will post follow-ups in the revert PR and linked perf ticket.
ci-bot: nightly/perf-small-seq now passing on canary after rollback (p99 within baseline).
